verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the LaunchDarkly product. The MCP server lets an external AI client query flags and observability data in natural language, but that runs outside the product. Stale-flag detection and Bayesian 'leading variation' highlighting are rule-based or statistical analytics, not AI insights. LLM-as-a-judge evaluates the customer's own AI features rather than producing insights from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
